title: My 2 Games
author: FarPlace9870
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I've made two mobile games in pretty different ways and wanted to share both.

The first one is ZeroPath, and it's 100% made with AI. I didn't write a single line of code myself, I just wanted to see how far you could get that way. It's a number puzzle: you drag your finger across the squares, each one you pass over goes down by one, and you have to get them all to zero in a single stroke. It has 11 worlds, each adding a new mechanic, plus daily challenges with a global leaderboard. Here's the link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.zeropath.game

The second one, Tilt Jump, is my baby. It was my idea and I spent a year developing it. The only part I did with AI was the UI, because design really isn't my thing and I'd rather focus on everything else. \[What it's about, in one sentence.\] You can get it here: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sefotud.tiltjump

I'd really appreciate it if you gave them a try, especially the second one. And if you notice a big difference between the two, I'd like to hear about that too.

Criticism is welcome, that's what I'm posting for.
